concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-venmo-testing-go-live]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Venmo testing/go-live snapshot for limited Sandbox app-switch, nonce and dispute fixtures plus approval-dependent Production enablement; product-level rather than mobile-SDK-family authority
warnings: Keep Sandbox fixture behavior distinct from real Venmo-app purchases, Production transaction outcomes and live dispute outcomes.
Production enablement is stated as occurring upon application approval; the snapshot does not establish current merchant eligibility, approval or enablement.
The page names no platform or SDK version, so do not apply it as exact Android, iOS or JavaScript SDK-family behavior.
